title: 10,000-dollar step tax-cost model
scope: Illustrative federal and California income-tax amounts for a California resident who files single or married filing separately, with the selected amount treated as total taxable income.

model.filing_status: Single for federal purposes; Schedule X (single or married/RDP filing separately) for California
model.character: Ordinary income / net short-term capital gain rate model. This does not decide whether a Kalshi event contract is ordinary, capital, section 1256, or wagering income.
model.amount_definition: The selected amount is modeled as taxable income, not gross deposits, contract notional, account balance, or a Kalshi statement total.
excludes: long-term capital-gain rates and section 1256 mark-to-market
model.california_note: The California side uses the official 2025 Schedule X rate schedule. The current research record does not contain a final 2026 California individual rate schedule; the 2026 FTB estimated-tax instructions direct filers to use the 2025 tax table for that worksheet. Do not relabel the 2025 schedule as a 2026 final return calculation.
